intent.raw: Adicione other no runtime, e code também, pra que a gente nunca deixe de rodar um dispatch por nao ter tipo.
intent.objective: After a separately executed and reviewed bootstrap installs the minimum runtime support, govern and prove specialized code plus canonical other for every exact installed unmapped capability, with durable capability binding, connected handoffs, migration compatibility, integrity, and independent review.
intent.target_artifact: A Stage-A bootstrap receipt plus a separately generated, reviewed, compiled, opened, executed, closed, integrity-valid, and independently approved Stage-B governed verification; no commit.
intent.operator_sentence: Root orchestrates only; the dispatch architect, every Stage-A seat, every Stage-B opening builder, implementer, verifier, reviewer, repairer, and report writer are distinct delegated agents.

stage_a_bootstrap_contract.relationship_to_stage_b: External prerequisite, not a step, seat, child dispatch, or governed execution of this Stage-B dispatch.
stage_a_bootstrap_contract.authority: Direct subagent work explicitly authorized by the user's instruction to use necessary subagents and proceed. It is not ACI-bound, not ledger-governed, and must make no ACI, compile, open, or governed-dispatch claim.
stage_a_bootstrap_contract.sole_goal: Install only the minimum runtime support required for a later canonical governed Stage-B opening to resolve exact installed unmapped capabilities as other, preserve strict code, carry a durable capability-route binding, and compile canonical sequential connected inputs.
stage_a_bootstrap_contract.entry_condition: A dedicated bootstrap-contract author freezes this contract and its exact file/test scopes before any Stage-A worker launches. That author performs no baseline, implementation, test, review, repair, or reporting work.

roles.purpose: Record git status, exact in-scope hashes, and dirty diffs, especially local_pilot.py and the stage-E source manifest.

owns: minimum new capability-route contract module if required
roles.purpose: Install specialized-first generic other, strict code preservation, durable route binding, and singular/plural schema migration.
Install canonical sequential handoff and digest-bound dynamic-input manifest compilation only.
Add deterministic Stage-A positive and negative tests. These exact files remain exclusively Stage-A-owned and are read-only in Stage B.
After all Stage-A target and test bytes are final, minimally regenerate integrity pins while preserving baseline user hunks or block on semantic overlap.
Attack the entire frozen Stage-A corpus through fidelity/governance only.
Attack the entire frozen Stage-A corpus through mechanics/correctness only.
Attack the entire frozen Stage-A corpus through abuse/gaming only.
Deduplicate attacker findings; persist only supported candidates.
Refute unsupported findings; never edit targets or review.md.
Prove target-by-lens coverage and trigger the all-zero-findings flag.
Approve only final frozen hashes with complete coverage and no CRITICAL/MAJOR finding.

required_behavior: Specialized mappings win: domainspec-implement remains code and retains the full existing code_contract/readiness/scope/topology contract.

An exact installed capability lacking a specialized mapping resolves to canonical other while its identity, skill path, digest, explicit authority mode, and tool profile are retained in an immutable capability-route receipt.
Missing, malformed, slash-qualified pseudo-capability, mismatched skill identity/path, unavailable authority, and post-confirmation route swaps fail closed; malformed code never degrades to other.

other is the canonical API/new-ledger value under a schema-version bump. Historical others remains byte-for-byte readable, closable, and aggregatable; API alias others normalizes new requests to other without rewriting history.
Appender, compile, open, host binding, and close verify the same route digest.
Canonical sequential connections materialize digest-bound downstream inputs; unsupported connection semantics fail explicitly.
test_contract: Registry migration and schema bump; singular new rows; mixed-version historical plural read/close/UI aggregation.
Several exact installed unmapped capabilities independently resolve to other; specialized capabilities retain their types.
Unknown, qualified, malformed, unavailable, swapped, missing-route, and forged-route cases fail closed.
Valid code passes only with full readiness; missing/failing readiness, scope escape, topology inflation, mixed code/other, and fallback attempts fail.
Appender, resolver, compiler, open, bridge, host binding, close, sequential topology, dynamic inputs, tampered manifests, and unsupported edges are covered.
Integrity manifest and local-pilot pin suites pass after exact preservation of pre-existing dirty hunks.
repair_order: Original production owners repair verified target defects.
a_test_implementer updates only its two exclusive files and runs the full Stage-A suite.
a_integrity_owner runs after every changed byte is final.
A new frozen Stage-A hash manifest is produced.
The complete attacker→writer↔skeptic→coverage→approver graph reruns over that manifest.
stage_a_bootstrap_contract.terminal_receipt: stage-a/approval.json must record explicit direct-subagent authority, no ACI claim, every agent id and terminal join/close state, exact final hashes, test commands/results, review coverage, and PASS. Stage B is blocked without it.

stage_b_entry_gate.condition: Stage A is complete outside this dispatch and its independently reviewed approval receipt is PASS. The unmodified post-Stage-A runtime must resolve and compile the governed Stage-B parent plus every separately authored and reviewed capability-specific child opening before this dispatch begins.
required_preflight: Verify Stage-A approval and final-hash manifest digests.
A parent-opening author generates one non-mutating governed parent verification opening whose only authority is dependency orchestration, receipt joining, and terminal success computation.

Separate child-opening authors generate at minimum: one canonical other opening for an exact installed unmapped fixture capability; strict code openings with full code_contract and PASS readiness fixtures for every mutation/test/route/integrity/repair child; and specialized review openings for attack, writer, skeptic, coverage, and approval children.

An orchestrate child may exist only if Stage A explicitly registered orchestrate authority; otherwise reporting uses another exact installed unmapped capability whose declared contract permits report writing.

A distinct read-only opening reviewer who authored no parent or child opening verifies exact opening, route, readiness, input-manifest, authority, topology, and hash boundaries and persists one opening-review receipt before any compilation or open.
Run appender validation and compile every parent and child opening to a non-empty generated launch plan under its own resolved route.
Only after independent opening-review PASS may the parent and children register/open through subagents-dispatch-lifecycle; every child uses only its own generated ACI binding.
stage_b_entry_gate.on_fail: Do not start this dispatch. Return exact Stage-A or parent/child preflight residue to the owning opening author; the reviewer never repairs.

stage_b_parent_child_contract.parent_authority: Non-mutating verification parent only: validate child prerequisites, release dependency-bound child inputs, join exact child receipts, compute success, and close after every child is terminal. It cannot lend its type or capability authority to a child.

required_children.capability: one exact installed unmapped fixture capability
required_children.purpose: Prove canonical generic resolution, durable route binding, connected input consumption, execution, and close without code authority.

Own every Stage-B mutation, test, route migration, integrity, or repair under a complete pinned code_contract, PASS readiness receipt, exact write scope, validation commands, and canonical code topology.
Own independent attackers, writer, skeptic, coverage auditor, and dedicated approver under separately connected review children/openings.

required_children.capability: orchestrate only if Stage A explicitly registered that authority; otherwise another exact installed unmapped report-writing capability
required_children.purpose: Author and, when necessary, repair the user report before integrity and final review.

stage_b_parent_child_contract.child_lifecycle: Each child has its own immutable route receipt, independently reviewed opening hash, compile receipt, parent-issued input manifest, open/session receipt, generated binding, execution/artifact receipt, terminal close receipt, and output manifest. A child output is unavailable downstream until all of these verify.
stage_b_parent_child_contract.dependency_handoffs: The parent releases only digest-bound outputs named by an upstream terminal child into the exact governed input slots of the next child. Missing, stale, cross-capability, unreviewed, unclosed, or digest-mismatched receipts block the handoff.
stage_b_parent_child_contract.success_join: PASS requires the parent receipt plus terminal PASS receipt sets for generic-other-fixture, every strict-code child, every specialized-review child, and report-writing; every launched child must be joined and closed, all declared dependencies consumed, final integrity/hash manifest frozen after the report, and the dedicated approver must name every final hash including the report hash.
forbidden: No other opening may authorize domainspec-implement mutation.
No code opening may authorize review or generic fixture work.
No parent type may substitute for a child's resolved type.
No child output may be passed by prompt prose instead of the governed input manifest.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Stage-B verification, independent review, and reporting require identity-separated delegated seats.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Stage A installs the minimum bootstrap outside governed semantics; Stage B independently proves that the installed runtime can govern its own exact capability, code, and connected-input behavior.
context: No Stage-B role is used before Stage-A PASS and successful governed preflight.
Stage-A test files are immutable inputs in Stage B; Stage-B tests use separately named files.

roles.purpose: Generate only the non-mutating governed parent verification opening and parent join contract.
Generate separate exact child openings and route/readiness/input contracts for other, strict code, review, and conditional reporting authorities.
Read-only independent review of every parent/child opening and route hash before compile/open; authors no opening and repairs nothing.
Execute positive and negative governed runtime verification without production mutation.
Normalize qualified pseudo-capabilities to exact installed IDs plus step-local modes and compile the parent route.
roles.owns: implementation-dispatch.json and its canonical opening only.

roles.purpose: After every Stage-B mutation and test is final, preserve dirty user hunks and regenerate integrity pins.
Attack every frozen Stage-B target through fidelity/governance only.
Attack every frozen Stage-B target through mechanics/correctness only.
Attack every frozen Stage-B target through abuse/gaming only.
Write only supported candidate findings.
Refute unsupported findings independently.
Own coverage proof and all-zero-findings flag.
Approve only final complete hashes; perform no other role.
Write the evidence-bounded user-facing report before integrity freeze and repair only verified report findings before retest, integrity, and rereview.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Already authorized by the user; Stage B additionally requires its explicit entry gate.

gates.condition: Stage A ran outside this dispatch under explicit direct-subagent authority, made no ACI claim, and has reviewed PASS receipts for every terminal seat.

The independent reviewer verifies the complete parent/child launch set and route hashes before each separately authorized opening compiles to a non-empty plan; no singular mixed-authority opening exists.
Specialized mappings win; other covers only exact installed unmapped capabilities with immutable identity/path/digest/authority/tool evidence; unknown and malformed identities fail.
Code remains specialized and readiness-gated; no code failure degrades to other.
Singular/plural migration, durable route binding, sequential connected inputs, compile/open/binding/close, and negative abuse fixtures all pass.
Integrity runs after all target/test mutations, never in parallel with producers, preserves dirty user hunks, and freezes the exact corpus reviewed.
Separate attackers feed writer↔skeptic convergence, then coverage, then a dedicated approver; rereview instantiates the same graph.

The governed parent and every separately authorized other/code/review/report child compiled, opened, executed, and closed; dependency manifests and success join verified; tests/integrity passed; and the complete final-hash review including report hash has no CRITICAL/MAJOR finding.
Type classification never becomes capability authority; passing tests establish only tested predicates; no commit or promotion occurs.

observability.signal_grouping: Stage-A direct receipts and Stage-B governed ACI receipts are separate namespaces and never conflated; every seat has exact authority, artifacts, hashes, tests, blockers, residue, join, and close evidence.

boundaries.contract: Only a reviewed external Stage-A PASS plus independently reviewed and separately compiled parent/child launch set authorizes Stage B; Stage A is never represented as an in-dispatch unbound seat.

The non-mutating parent joins receipts and releases governed input manifests; each other, code, review, and conditional report child compiles, opens, executes, and closes under its own resolved route and cannot borrow parent or sibling authority.
other is a type for an exact installed capability whose durable route identity remains independently verified; code retains its specialized contract.
Repairs finish first, disjoint tests finish second, integrity freezes third, and full review consumes exactly that manifest.

authority.lifecycle: Stage A explicit direct-subagent contract outside dispatch; Stage B governed lifecycle only
authority.validation: disjoint test/integrity owners plus canonical multi-lens review graph
authority.evidence: separate Stage-A and Stage-B receipt namespaces

promotion_guardrails: Stage-A direct authorization is never described as ACI governance.

Stage B cannot claim success from compile alone; its parent and every capability-specific child must independently compile, open, run, consume governed inputs, close, and join before integrity and review PASS.
Generic other supplies classification, not authority.
Code never falls back to other.
The user report is frozen and reviewed before approval; after PASS only lifecycle receipts outside the target corpus may append, and root may relay the approved report without substantive rewriting.
No artifact is promoted and no commit is created.
